2. This first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C/483 of BNSS has been filed for grant of bail.

3. Applicant has been arrested on 04.05.2024 in connection with Crime No.80/2024 registered by Police Station Amola, District Shivpuri for offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

4. In view of the DNA test report as well as the injuries found on the body of the prosecutrix, learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application.
5.
It is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE bj/-
